evidence.quote: Open at an ambitious but defensible share of the disputed charges, with fees separately stated and any fee reduction benefiting the class rather than Brightline.
Term sheet: class fund $48,000,000; attorneys' fees $10,000,000; clear sailing yes; unawarded fees revert to defendant no; distribution automatic
$40 million for the class, with a $6 million fee request subject to court approval, no clear-sailing commitment, and any amount not awarded going to the class.
We accept Brightline’s latest term sheet.

summary: Hargrove first raised fees in its opening position, and fees and class relief were negotiated together before the final Round 3 acceptance. The transcript expressly links fee treatment to class recovery by proposing that unawarded or reduced fees go to the class. There is no clear evidence that plaintiff counsel pursued its own fee interest, that defense leveraged that interest, that any reverse auction occurred, or that the court declaration misstated the negotiation sequence.
